name: Tag, You're It
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps play the strategy guide's kill plan, which no sample deck holds its payoffs for — Scorched Earth and Retribution behind Public Trail, Ping and Funhouse, with Clearinghouse for the damage a trap finishes and Orbital Superiority for the tag a score gives — on Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World, an identity no sample deck uses (Phase 5 §25 Stage 6). The bot plays it under the kill plan: a tag is worth what the Corp holds to punish it, and a grip under the damage in hand is the threat. Eternal-legal only. Parhelion Stage 3a: two Regulatory Capture for its two Sacrifice Zone Expansion, a requirement of 6 its bad publicity lowers. Parhelion Stage 5c: two Kimberlite Field for two of its three Orbital Superiority, a scored agenda that trashes a rezzed card for a Runner card no dearer, and two Yakov Erikovich Avdakov for its two Regolith Mining License, credits for every trash from its server.
